name: Immrse
tagline: Enterprise cold-immersion infrastructure, measured to the second.
positioning: Immrse operates and instruments corporate cold-plunge studios so people teams can offer recovery as a metered benefit — with utilization data, safety logs, and per-session billing that fits procurement.

hero.h1: Cold-immersion recovery, operated as enterprise infrastructure.
hero.sub: Immrse designs, staffs, and instruments on-site cold-plunge studios for large organizations — turning a wellness amenity into a governed, per-session service line with full utilization reporting.

features.title: Metered per-session billing
features.description: Every plunge is logged, timestamped, and reconciled to a cost center. Finance receives a single monthly invoice with department-level utilization, not a flat retainer nobody can defend.

features.title: Temperature & safety compliance
features.description: Continuous water-temp telemetry, sanitation cycles, and staffed supervision logs are captured automatically and exported to your EHS and audit systems on demand.

features.title: Occupancy scheduling
features.description: Employees book slots through SSO; capacity, cooldown intervals, and contraindication screening are enforced before the door unlocks.

features.title: Multi-site standardization
features.description: Roll out identical studio specifications across campuses with centralized provisioning, so a plunge in Austin performs exactly like one in Frankfurt.

features.title: Utilization analytics
features.description: Track adoption by team, cost-per-session trends, and peak-load windows in a dashboard your people ops leaders can present to the board.

features.title: Managed operations
features.description: Certified attendants, water treatment, and maintenance are handled under one SLA. You approve the program; we run the floor.

testimonials.quote: We replaced a chaotic vendor patchwork with one metered contract. Immrse gives our CFO a defensible cost-per-session line and our EHS team the compliance logs they used to chase manually.
testimonials.name: Dana Reinholt

testimonials.quote: Rolling recovery studios across six campuses used to be impossible to standardize. Immrse delivered identical specs and telemetry everywhere, and our utilization data finally holds up in leadership reviews.
testimonials.name: Marcus Feld

testimonials.quote: The per-session model changed the conversation entirely. We stopped guessing at ROI and started reporting it. Adoption on our engineering floors is now a metric we actually watch.
testimonials.name: Priya Anand
